rule: Zero metadata on EVERY deliverable (video, image, pfp, cover, thumbnail, start frame, any file): no EXIF/XMP/C2PA/encoder/AI tags. Auto-stripped then re-verified.
Finished videos go to Omar as in-chat attachments/players, never Drive links.
Every generation is 720p, hooks included (supersedes 'hook 1080p' F10/R10). Final export is 720x1280.
Hook = its own single 4 s generation; body clips packed 2 per 4 s generation joined by a hard cut.
Every gen <= 5 s (4 s typical), never 8 s; hook <= 5 s on screen.
Seedance 2.5 only (no Kling); start frames only, never end frames.
Stills are GPT Image 2 only and every start frame has its product/cast refs attached.
Start frames are shown to Omar before any clip spend.
No credit spend without Omar's approved plan + cap; total spend stays within the cap; always list cost.
Every prompt ends with the iPhone-12 realism suffix (no blur, no warm light, nothing cinematic).
Start frames/footage look like a genuine iPhone photo, not AI slop.
No visible grain or sharpening in the grade.
A US flag is visible in the video (every clip where plausible), big enough to read.
Gaze and physics correct: no phasing, no blank stares at camera unless staged.
Natural motion; no permanent shock face; not slow/robotic.
Time of day progresses chronologically; settings are relatable homes.
Product shown working and exactly matching the real product (colour, density, box) in every shot.
Every video fully unique: zero footage shared with any other video on any page (perceptual hash vs all registered/posted videos).
Never the same video on 2 pages, and never repost a video (reposts get shadowbanned).
No race-based casting; never sexualize or feature minors; exclude FEMBOY child content.
Only active products (jollyglow_curtain, trumpglow, purrventure_carrier, lumarein); retired products are reference data only; no Roblox.
Hook is a proven POC format (formats/index.json) or a truly scroll-stopping relevant moment; every element POC-backed.
Real point of conflict/action visible in the first second.

3-2-1 spec: covered product cue at 0 s, everyone counts together, 'let's see how it comes out' on the reveal, split-second (<=0.5 s) reveal, full product saved for the afters, count voices ~+8 LU over the song.
Song starts at frame 0 (no silent lead-in) and plays continuously: no loops, no splices (audio fingerprint vs the reference song).
Recreations use the competitor's exact song AND section (verified fingerprint in refs/<slug>/songs_verified.json).
No phonk / slowed+reverb; proven song section people actually use.
Real ambient clip audio only, never fake SFX; voices audible over the song.
Straight hard cuts only: no fades, no jump cut inside one take, no lingering boring shot.
The payoff/after is >= 2 hard cuts (3+ shots), no payoff shot > 1.5 s, never one cinematic shot.

ONE on-screen card by default; a 2nd only for a problem-vs-solution / then-vs-now hook or a closing 'get it from the caption below 👇' card; 3 cards ONLY for the MR52 idea / VS / result structure (VS on the middle card); never 4+.
Every card is <= 8 words.
'VS' only ever on the middle card, never on the first card.
No 'Get yours' and no URL on screen or in captions.
Card emojis are Apple iOS (Apple Color Emoji) art, pixel-verified against textcards.
Every card is visible from its shot's first frame (starts on a cut +-1 frame, >= 1 s, readable contrast on the render).
Card copy makes literal logical sense for what is on screen.
Cards never cover a face.
Rendered card text matches the approved card copy (OCR) and fits in <= 2 rows.
FB/IG captions use SAY "<KEYWORD>", never 'Comment'.
Before publish the exact caption equals the approved caption and every card equals the approved card spec.
No caption line repeats a line already posted on that page.
Caption is a proven hook-style caption (not a store listing title); no engagement-bait questions.
Nothing is posted without Omar's approval or explicit ask for that post.
Caption swap only at 40K views or 10K+ within an hour.
Superseded Drive versions get trashed after a new version ships.
Every Omar fix becomes a permanent rule in this file plus an automated check or required review item.
Never burn in captions (F04) - SUPERSEDED: on-screen cards are now required (D188); post captions live in the FB caption.

Glow trail / motion blur behind lights is EXTREMELY minimal, close to none: no streaks behind the horse at all, only the bright glow on the product itself (white-hot cores + halo/bloom). Post trail pass: lagfun decay <= 0.3 and trail opacity <= 0.03 (default 0 = no trail pass); prompts must say 'no light trails, no motion streaks, no long-exposure effect' and never ask for trails; any clip with visible streaks is rejected.
sources: Omar 2026-10-21 8:14 PM (LR1/LR2 trails way too much); tightened Omar 2026-10-22 10:37 AM (frame with long leg streaks: ~3% or zero)

rule: Problem-vs-solution card pairs use 'The solution' as the second card, never 'The result' ('The problem' -> 'The solution').

No illogical settings for the product: every scene is a place the product/subject would actually be. PurrVentures: the cat never appears in a store or garden center - use yards, parks, patios and similar.

VS / idea-vs-result videos have 3 parts in order: (1) HOOK = the problem, only the makeshift janky version (duct tape etc.); (2) VS = a separate segment right after the hook showing the product being ASSEMBLED / put on the horse, the VS card starts here; (3) RESULT = the afters, riding with the bright glow, >= 2 hard cuts. Never skip the VS assembly segment. Spec shots carry role hook/vs/after.
Barn Glow / LumaRein afters ALWAYS include multiple glowing horses: at least one after shot with 2+ horses wearing the product (spec shots[].horses, confirmed on the render).
sources: Omar 2026-10-22 11:43 AM PT (LR4 had only single-horse afters)

rule: Assembly / VS segments are never rushed: the product assembly reads clearly, >= 2.0 s on screen and >= the reference's assembly length (spec.reference.assembly_s) when recreating.

The song's beat drop lands exactly on the first frame of the afters (+-0.1 s): drop detected by onset/energy analysis of the used song section; align song in_s (or the cut) so the drop hits the after cut.

Barn Glow afters = EXACTLY three back-to-back cinematic cuts of the glowing horses running, in relevant settings only (farm, barn in the background, occasionally a beach); never irrelevant places. With MR53, at least one of the three shows multiple horses. Spec after shots carry setting + action.
